y=dA_dt
def lm(f,p0,it=200):
    p=p0.copy(); lam=1e-2
    def r(p): return y-f(p)
    e=r(p); cost=e@e
    for _ in range(it):
        J=np.zeros((len(y),len(p)))
        for j in range(len(p)):
            dp=np.zeros(len(p)); dp[j]=1e-7*max(1,abs(p[j]))
            J[:,j]=-(r(p+dp)-e)/dp[j]
        g=J.T@e; H=J.T@J
        ok=False
        for _ in range(15):
            try: step=np.linalg.solve(H+lam*np.diag(np.diag(H)+1e-9),g)
            except Exception: lam*=10; continue
            pn=p+step; en=r(pn); cn=en@en
            if np.isfinite(cn) and cn<cost:
                p,e,cost=pn,en,cn; lam=max(lam/3,1e-9); ok=True; break
            lam*=4
        if not ok or cost<1e-20: break
    return cost/len(y)/np.var(y), p
